description: Migrate a SysML v1 model — UML XMI with the SysML profile, an Eclipse UML2 .uml file or a Cameo/MagicDraw .mdzip archive — to SysML v2 in one of the representations convert writes (the Migrate RPC, the CLI's -migrate). Migration is not lossless: every v1 element is mapped, approximated, left unmapped or skipped, and `report` accounts for each. Nothing is written to disk: the migrated model comes back as `content`, with any image files it refers to in `files`. The result is the MigrateResponse as protojson writes it.

content.description: the v1 document inline, base64-encoded (an .mdzip archive is binary); fromFormat must then say what it is

filePath.description: the v1 model file to migrate (.xmi, .uml or .mdzip), absolute or relative to the workspace root

fromFormat.description: xmi (UML XMI 2.5.1 with the SysML profile), uml (Eclipse UML2) or mdzip (Cameo/MagicDraw); empty infers from filePath's extension

imageBaseUrl.description: absolute http(s) URL a server-relative image reference in a v1 comment is resolved against

layoutContent.description: the MTIP export inline, instead of layoutPath

layoutPath.description: an MTIP export of the model's diagrams (Model_mtip.xml) laying the migrated views out, absolute or relative to the workspace root

report.description: carry every element's verdict (mapped, approximated, unmapped, skipped) and the report text; the summary and counts come regardless

results.description: carry the result snapshots the v1 tool stored with the model, as sysml -compare-results reads them

strict.description: write only notation a pinned SysML v2 production admits; a construct whose only v2 form is an OpenSysML extension is reported unmapped instead

toFormat.description: format to write: sysml, kerml, text, ttl, turtle, rdf, api-json or json

name: migrate
